title: Beyond Model Ranking: Regime Diagnosis for Distributional-Statistical Misspecification in Industrial Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.40117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series forecasting models achieve strong benchmark performance but exhibit severe systematic bias in industrial deployments. This train--deploy gap is conventionally attributed to temporal-structural errors or distribution shifts. We characterize a complementary source that these explanations overlook: canonical losses embed fixed statistical priors, while industrial demand mixes benign and pathological regimes---zero-inflation, skewness, high variability---in which these priors are systematically violated. The induced bias persists even under perfect temporal modeling, remains in a distributional-shape component that normalization cannot remove, and creates an aggregation trade-off invisible to aggregate metrics. translated_title: 超越模型排名：工业时间序列预测中分布-统计误设的状态诊断
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测模型在基准测试中表现优异，但在工业部署中却表现出严重的系统性偏差。这种“训练—部署”差距通常被归因于时间结构误差或分布偏移。我们刻画了这些解释所忽视的一个互补性来源：标准损失函数嵌入了固定的统计先验，而工业需求混合了良性状态与病态状态——零膨胀、偏斜、高变异性——在这些状态下，这些先验会被系统性违反。由此产生的偏差即使在完美的时间建模下依然存在，并保留在归一化无法消除的分布形状分量中，进而造成聚合指标无法察觉的聚合权衡。我们将这些观察转化为一个以状态相对偏差向量为核心的评估工具包：这是一种与具体度量无关、按状态分解的诊断工具，用于审计池化训练如何在各需求状态间分配系统性失配。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文指出了工业时间序列预测中“训练—部署”差距的一个被忽视的根源——标准损失函数内嵌的固定统计先验在零膨胀、偏斜、高变异性等病态需求状态下被系统性违反——并提出了以状态相对偏差向量（RBV）为核心的、与度量无关的按状态分解诊断工具包，用于审计池化训练在各状态间的系统性失配分配。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies an overlooked source of the train-deploy gap in industrial time-series forecasting—the fixed statistical priors embedded in canonical losses being systematically violated in pathological demand regimes such as zero-inflation, skewness, and high variability—and introduces a metric-agnostic, regime-decomposed diagnostic toolkit centered on the Regime-wise Relative Bias Vector (RBV) to audit how pooled training allocates systematic mismatch across regimes.
